verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an official web crawler or data-source connectors for Elasticsearch. What it does cover is automatic embedding generation for semantic_text fields and official client libraries, which are developer building blocks for writing your own indexing pipeline rather than a managed ingestion capability. Ingestion connectors are a fair axis for a search engine, so the verdict is none, not na.

support.subject: As a founder, I can ingest content with an official crawler or connectors instead of writing my own indexing pipeline
